introduction: Explore Lava Springs, gather Drembel’s exact materials and commission Cinder, while following the separate town, tyrant and Qin skull stories.
orientation: Explore Lava Springs from the installed surface approach, meet Drembel and follow his Cinder commission. Discovery records your actual arrival; the request is revealed by meeting the blacksmith.
Ask Drembel about hi, lava, rock, weapon, forge, need, want or armor. These eight aliases share one room-wide response, rather than eight separate quests.
Drembel needs five exact lava rocks and one exact flaming-longsword voucher. The para-elemental figures carry the rocks around the crater; Fonlak stocks the voucher in the Depositary Stronghold.

Drembel recommends buying the voucher. Native purchases are currently unavailable while accounting is active. An exact supplied voucher or supplied rocks also fit the commission; remembered purchase or personal kills are not native requirements.

Gather all five rocks and the voucher loose in your inventory before offering a requested item to Drembel. The accounting path selects distinct materials and commits the complete set together; an incomplete set stays with you.

Current materials are preparation, and the accepted exchange is history. Holding Cinder, the crystal skull, an elixir or equipment cannot create the forging receipt. Consuming materials or losing the reward does not erase acceptance.
The voucher has a nominal cost, but native price policy can vary the actual purchase amount. Payment, voucher issuance, supplied custody and forging completion are separate outcomes.

The crater and lava tubes use real fire-plane terrain. Entry schedules heat effects; protection can be removed, some actors benefit from fire, and ordinary actors can suffer damage. Entering a room alone does not prove survival or safe return.
The platform above the lava tube has a different terrain type. Opening a lava-pit, tube or plank door and crossing it are distinct from recovering a rock or forging Cinder.

Voinak carries a strange crystal skull requested by Qin in Drifting Realm. It is one of five distinct skulls in that separate return; local possession or defeating Voinak does not complete Qin’s quest or Drembel’s commission. The skull is authored as hidden, cannot be dropped and cannot be rented; recovering it and making an accepted foreign return need their actual admission.
The forgotten inn has a rent handler and the vacant room has a healing control. Neither peaceful wording nor bank safety prose adds a safe-room flag.

The counter has a locker interaction with account, town, combat and service admission. Paid locker services are currently unavailable under active accounting; the sign’s banking words do not prove a completed deposit or safe storage.

The mechanized replicas follow selected residents as native guards. Hiring, freeing or restoring a construct needs a defined beneficiary and lasting result; native follower stock is separate from a player’s hire receipt.
The elixir of lifeforce is configured for an aging spell. Its name does not promise healing or restoration; possession and actual admitted effects are different facts.

Town defenses, abandoned homes, demonic hosts, vampires and Voinak’s rule suggest wider investigation, aid and restoration stories. Builders must define actual contributions, agency, beneficiaries and lasting outcomes.
New tracking requires active READY accounting. Daily replay remains disabled until source generations, purchases, the six-item exchange, reward/save/replay and renewed availability are qualified.

stories.title: Commission Cinder from Drembel
stories.summary: Offer five exact lava rocks and one exact sword voucher for Cinder. Current materials and accepted history are separate; purchase, heat survival and Qin’s skull return have distinct outcomes.

steps.text: Carry five exact lava rocks loose
steps.hint: The five para-elemental figures around the crater are declared sources. Exact supplied rocks also fit. This row shows the current quantity without recording personal kills or first-source recovery.

steps.text: Carry the exact flaming-longsword voucher loose
steps.hint: Fonlak stocks the voucher in the Depositary Stronghold, but native purchases currently refuse under active accounting. An exact supplied copy also fits; current custody does not certify a purchase.

Bring all five rocks and the voucher loose, then offer a requested item to Drembel. One accepted six-item exchange records the sword reward. Incomplete materials, reward custody, dialogue, payment or the crystal skull cannot create this receipt.
